context: 18_displacement: the residual on the 13 sole-failure documents is TWO constructs whose errors cancel, and that is why 20 attempts moved 4. Four live Google round trips this slot: med_dy -2.8 (362_price_list_dense), -3.0 (bus-timetable), -6.7 (mobile-bill), -13.0 (72_bank_statement); worst_dy 5.4/4.9/10.0/28.2; med_dx -0.2..+0.2 on all four; bad_pages [0] on all four. Run-by-run profiles: at every table's block top the gap is lost (-8.76, -4.19, -4.08 pt on mobile-bill) and inside every table each row is laid 0.75 pt too tall, so dy climbs back to 0 at the footer. 24 rows x 0.75 = 18 pt of ramp against 17.0 pt of step. Each half refuted alone because spending the spacer overflows (the DocxWriter guard at :6074 names mobile-bill and insurance-policy-schedule) and the row declaration change alone leaves the step uncompensated. The untried pair: deliver the gap through the first-row cell w:before (measured 1:1 by Google, 66 probes, error 0.000000) AND reduce w:trHeight by the same per-row amount, so the table total is unchanged. 362_price_list_dense has no step, only a monotone ramp, so it is the document that proves or refutes the pair.
